# Preface {.unnumbered}

This is an open textbook for a first course in statistics. It is written in
[Quarto](https://quarto.org) and built automatically on GitHub.

## How to read this book {.unnumbered}

- Code examples appear in **R** or **Julia**. Each chapter uses one language;
  the language is noted at the top of the chapter.
- Chapters marked *interactive* include small apps that run entirely in your
  browser (no installation needed).

## Contributing {.unnumbered}

Spotted a typo or an unclear explanation? Use the **Edit this page** or
**Report an issue** links in the sidebar.
